exposure: Type of cesarean section (extraperitoneal vs. transperitoneal)
finding: Extraperitoneal cesarean section in primiparous women resulted in shorter operation duration and fewer neonatal transfers compared to transperitoneal cesarean section, with no difference in other maternal or neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Extraperitoneal cesarean section resulted in neonates with higher birth weights and fewer neonatal transfers compared to transperitoneal cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonates in the extraperitoneal cesarean section group had higher birth weights
